attributes.title: AOSSM Annual Meeting 2027
attributes.venue: Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center
attributes.organizer: American Orthopaedic Society for Sports Medicine
attributes.summary:
The American Orthopaedic Society for Sports Medicine brings its 2027 Annual Meeting to Boston, July 7 to 10, at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center. The meeting is aimed at orthopaedic surgeons who treat sports injuries, and the program is built from submitted abstracts and instructional courses.

AOSSM had posted only the dates and venue for 2027 when we checked. The abstract window for this edition has closed, with decisions due in early 2027. Fees, credit hours and hotel blocks should appear on the society's meeting site closer to the date.
